answer: Registration also requires a tiny ocean-minted deposit held in escrow, slashed if the agent is later flagged by peer attestation. Each new agent must stake a jade token locked to a unique hardware attestation and complete a proof-of-work tied to the current comet epoch, making mass identity creation costly since every fake account burns real stake. Attackers must therefore pay per identity and risk losing collateral, turning sybil farming into an economically irrational strategy. In practice, sa0024 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
